scientific_integrity: All-size proofs are given; finite simulation supports but does not replace them. Related prior tree-matching theorem and classical Lucas enumeration are explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: Class-conditional spectra only; no arrival probabilities or time to reach the recurrent set. The Lucas identity is classical. Historical priority may be incomplete; no independent scientific audit has been performed.
title: Parity-filtered attractors and exact relaxation spectra for stochastic minority on partially whiskered cycles
